en: Black‑and‑white (slightly sepia) postcard view of a cobblestone market square bordered by multi‑story historic townhouses with shops on the ground floor. A few people stand along the facades. In the background, a large wind turbine or windmill structure rises above the rooftops against a forested hillside. The caption in red Gothic-style type at the top reads "Thum i. Erzgeb. Marktplatz." Additional German shop signs are visible on the buildings.
